errors.text_span: Диаграмата представя количествено отношението на хора към оценка на киберсигурност
errors.evidence: The chart's purpose is not to show the 'attitude of people towards a cybersecurity assessment', but to show the answers to the question in the title: 'When a problem occurred, did the cybersecurity people treat you well and with respect?'.
The description omits the category 'По-скоро да;' (Rather yes;) from the list of x-axis categories.
The category on the x-axis is 'Не, изобщо;' (No, not at all;), not 'Не, особено' (No, particularly).
The category on the x-axis is written in the first person: 'Не мога да преценя;' (I can't judge;), not in the impersonal form 'Не може да се прецени' (It cannot be judged).

errors.text_span: стълбът "Не, особено" е с височина 5, а стълбът "По-скоро не" е с височина 3
errors.evidence: The description swaps the values for two categories. The bar for 'Не, изобщо;' (mislabeled as 'Не, особено') has a value of 3, and the bar for 'По-скоро не;' has a value of 5.
The description fails to report the value for the category 'По-скоро да;', which has a value of 37, equal to the highest value reported.
